details: For every finite concept class, $\mathrm{TD}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{STD}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: An ordinary minimum teaching set is admissible at the first subset-teaching step because it is inconsistent with every competing concept. The subset-teaching iterations only permit further reductions, so their stabilized maximum cannot exceed ordinary teaching dimension.
name: Teaching Dimension / Subset Teaching Dimension
